name: Gini coefficient

subjectOf.text: Agentic automation concentrates agency in opportunity hubs and, through winner takes most swarms, elevates Gini coefficients by 15 to 25 percent by 2030, which is why diversity mandates are required for inclusive ecosystems.
subjectOf.abstract: Agentic automation concentrates agency in opportunity hubs, elevating Gini coefficients by 15–25% by 2030 through winner-takes-most swarms, demanding diversity mandates for inclusive ecosystems
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The AI-to-AI Economy and the Collapse of Anthropocentric Economic Theory (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5886442
scope_conditions: assumes winner takes most swarm dynamics without corrective mandates

subjectOf.text: High concentration of reputation among foundational contributors is socially optimal because it correctly prices the nonrivalrous, increasing returns character of foundational knowledge.
subjectOf.abstract: This is socially optimal because it correctly prices the nonrivalrous, increasing-returns nature of foundational knowledge.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Evolution of Domain-Specific Reputation Systems From Binary Validation to Citation-Weighted Knowledge Attribution (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6192998
